instruction: Make Yahoo the search engine used for all my browser searches.

metadata.explanation: Task requires changing Chrome's default search engine to Yahoo. Uses existing getter 'get_default_search_engine' which reads Chrome preferences file and extracts the default search engine name. Metric 'match_in_list' checks if the result matches 'Yahoo!' or 'Yahoo' (both variants accepted). Postconfig restarts Chrome to ensure settings are persisted. Same pattern as original task, just different search engine.

llm_judge_reasons: Getter 'get_default_search_engine' correctly reads Chrome's Preferences file from OS-specific paths and extracts the default search engine name from 'default_search_provider_data.template_url_data.short_name'
Metric 'match_in_list' appropriately checks if result is in expected list ['Yahoo!', 'Yahoo'], handling both common naming variants
Postconfig correctly restarts Chrome to ensure preferences are persisted to disk before verification
Complete coverage: evaluator verifies exactly what the instruction requires (Yahoo as default search engine)
Data compatibility: getter returns string, metric expects string in list - perfect semantic match
Good error handling: getter has try-except with fallback to 'Google', handles missing files and OS differences
Expected values are semantically correct and comprehensive for the task
